design: INDIVIDUAL 20: an exceptionally tall dignified ancient female councillor, slim powerful build, pale silver hide with fine dark mottles and broad cinematic cranial structure, waist-long white scalp tendrils held by a simple thin bronze nape ring. A long rich but worn purple split robe with a wide ivory front panel, asymmetric bronze neck collar and long embroidered teal rank ribbon. One hand holds a thin staff with a blunt open oval top, other presents a square bronze seal. No crown, no throne, no king regalia, quiet thoughtful authority.
